LAST CALL.

- 🔔 LAST (next to STOP): last call now, at a time (2:00 AM), or at a spot in the rotation.
- When it comes, LAST CALL flashes on every screen. The girl on stage finishes, the poles go off, the next 2 on Main are the last dancers, then a 2 FOR 1 with all girls on the floor, and the NEXT after that ends the night.
- The dressing room and iPads show it ahead of time with who the last dancers are.
